analyticalQuestion: Do the exact root-box intervals separate the sharp and in-plane consecutive coefficient-radius proxies on the certified finite window N=18,...,40?
supportedClaim: For every point in the certified R0.20 root box, rhoD_N < rhoA_N and Gamma_N > 1 hold at each N=18,...,40. The smallest certified Gamma lower bound on this window is 1.02943193018722498. These are finite exact inequalities, not an asymptotic or dominant-singularity theorem.

simulation.precision: exact GMP rational arithmetic; 256-bit MPFR used only to print decimal summaries and sigma values
simulation.solver: deterministic scalar Taylor recurrence; no iterative tolerance

tolerances.intervalArithmetic: none; every interval endpoint is rational

data.schema: One row for each N=18,...,40 with rhoA, the exact root-box decimal enclosure of rhoD, and the exact root-box decimal enclosure of Gamma. All quantities are dimensionless.
Append-only UTC timestamp, elapsed seconds, completed leaf count, and ordered scalar interaction count.
Five-second process-tree samples with UTC timestamp, elapsed seconds, status, process count, CPU percent, RSS MiB, and GPU fields.

sourceData.extractionCommand: read endpoints[N>=18].consecutiveRatios; plot.py writes the selected decimal enclosures to data.csv

caption.chineseSiteSummary: 根盒上每个 N=18 至 40 都有 rhoD_N < rhoA_N 与 Gamma_N > 1；阴影尾段只作有限精确摘要，不代表比值收敛。

qa.notes: PDF page size is 178 by 72 mm; the 600 dpi PNG is 4204 by 1700 pixels. Color and Generic Gray Gamma 2.2 renders were inspected at final layout. Solid-circle and dashed-square encodings remain distinct in grayscale. validate_data.py passed all 23 rows and reconstructed every exact separation inequality.
